cloudflare.kv.reads.note: Keys read (a bulk read counts every key), beyond the 10 million a month the plan includes. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.kv.storage.note: Beyond the 1 GB the plan includes. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.kv.writes.note: Keys written, keys deleted and list requests are each $5.00 per million beyond 1 million a month the plan includes. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
